Container.Name: wordcraft-web
Container.Overview: WordCraft Web is a community-maintained Docker image that serves WordCraft, a browser-based word processor written in Rust. The upstream application works with document formats including DOCX, ODT, RTF, HTML, Markdown, LaTeX, and TXT, and can export PDF. Documents are handled through the browser application and browser file operations; the container only serves the static WebAssembly frontend and does not provide centralized document storage or server-side document processing.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: WordCraft Word Craft Word Processor Document Editor DOCX ODT RTF HTML Markdown LaTeX PDF Browser WebAssembly WASM
Container.Requires: No special privileges, database, or persistent data volumes are required for the standard deployment. Documents are opened and saved through browser file handling and downloads. The container serves HTTP on port 8080. Use HTTPS through a reverse proxy for remote access where required by browser security restrictions.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: Host port used to access the WordCraft Web interface. The container listens on port 8080.
